_comment: EXECUTOR AUTHORING session permissions (Milestone 7), the executor-side mirror of watchdog.settings.json. The agent edits its own planner (AUTHORING_SESSION_DIR/planner, under executor/workspace/) and evaluates it through the executor-authoring MCP server; it needs no shell. Read is allowed for the executor-side repo (task file, executor parts, platform config, backend sources) and DENIED for everything WatchDog-side and for the episode records: records/ holds the ground-truth checker result and the WatchDog transcript, which reach the agent only through read_verdict, filtered by config/cell.yaml executor_feedback. Bash is denied because a shell bypasses every rule here (it could cat records/ or run the runner directly). Agent, Task and Workflow are denied because subagents read under their own permissions; Artifact, ShareOnboardingGuide, WebFetch and WebSearch are outbound channels. Edits are allowed only under executor/workspace/. Re-verify the tool list after a Claude Code upgrade: a tool added later is permitted by default.
_run_params_comment: RUN PARAMETERS: model and effortLevel, as in watchdog.settings.json. runner/run_authoring.sh passes this file with --settings and echoes both values.
